name: 6sense
description: 6sense account intelligence, 6QA trends, keyword and ad performance, website activity, segments — official MCP server (read-only)

requirements: 6sense account and credentials that can authorize the MCP server
Per-user authorization — each user authorizes with their own 6sense credentials
A license and role that allow MCP access (RBAC and AI settings control what is exposed)
notes: ALL MCP operations are READ-ONLY: the server cannot modify data.
Access honours the user's license and role; daily, weekly and monthly credit limits apply per user and per role.

Native APIs: Keyword Intent Data API v1 (OAuth 2.0; 3 credits per newly discovered account, non-matches are free), Company Identification API v3 (API token), Company Firmographics API v3, Lead Scoring API v2, People Search API v2, People Enrichment API v2, Server-Side Company Identification API v1.
People Search API and Lead Scoring API consume no credits.
